title: Allow pipeline finish to stage a reviewed rename
requirements: Repair Pipeline.finish so the validated allowed-path rename of a tracked file can be staged and merged. It must stage additions, modifications and deletions described by the already scope-validated snapshot; it must not broaden the task's allowed paths or bypass validation/review/base checks.

Add a regression test that creates a task with a committed file rename in its approved path, validates and reviews it, then proves finish merges the rename successfully. Preserve existing finish coverage and runner invariants.
Do not change product code, task-state recovery data, environment handling, integrations or documentation.
acceptance: A reviewed rename can complete through the same controller path as a normal change, and out-of-scope files remain excluded.
The full pipeline test suite and whitespace check pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Lead regression revealed that the controller correctly validates a rename but cannot stage its deleted source path during finish.
